Status of Wildlife between Kota Barrage and Jawahar Sagar Dam, Rajasthan

A WII rapid assessment report on aquatic wildlife and river habitat quality along the Chambal River stretch between Kota Barrage and Jawahar Sagar Dam.

Open archived PDF Original source All resources

Archive Metadata

Source: Wildlife Institute of India, Dehradun

Type: Technical report

Issued: 2021

Archived locally: 2026-05-21

File: 23 MB / 64 pages

Use This For

Use for Chambal river-valley context, otter signs, crocodile and turtle records, waterbirds, raptors, fish diversity, and development-impact interpretation around the wider Mukundara landscape.

This report can contain sensitive field locations. Use it for ecological context and citation, but avoid republishing precise nest, roost, or wildlife-use coordinates.
